title: FunctionCallingConfig
description: Configuration for specifying function calling behavior.

allowedFunctionNames.description: Optional. A set of function names that, when provided, limits the functions the model will call. This should only be set when the Mode is ANY or VALIDATED. Function names should match [FunctionDeclaration.name]. When set, model will predict a function call from only allowed function names.

mode.description: Optional. Specifies the mode in which function calling should execute. If unspecified, the default value will be set to AUTO.
